opening.argument: The video is framed as entertainment built around calls to people identified as scammers: its title describes a “Little Boy” calling “Angry Scammers,” while the description says the creator is “Trolling scammers” and will not give them money. The Windows Run-box instruction appears within a recorded call from a speaker presenting as technical support, who says “just press Win and R”; the available evidence does not show the creator directing viewers to follow that instruction, pay money, provide credentials, or install remote-access software. The closing instead asks viewers to help ensure nobody else falls for scams, while also requesting a subscription, supporting a prank-call and warning-oriented context.
